[[File:Double_Laser_Cannon_CCG.jpg|thumb|250px|An Me/7 on Jabba's Sail Barge]]
The '''Me/7 double laser cannon''', also known as the '''Me/7 heavy repeating dual laser cannon''', was a heavy repeating dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] had a single Me/7 turret installed aboard the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']]. During the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] rigged the Me/7 to fire at the ''Khetanna''{{'s}} own deck, destroying the [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]].
